learning_outcomes.text: Master the usual tools in measuring mechanical vibrations.

syllabus_topics: Smartphone as a tool for vibration acquisition and analysis
Computational analysis of 1-degree of freedom systems
Computational analysis of 2-degrees of freedom systems

assessment_methods.method: Written exam on concepts acquired in the course
Application assignments for knowledge acquired in practical sessions

assessment_rules: To pass the course, the written exam must be passed, and the weighted average of all evaluation elements (written exam and practical session scripts) must be equal to or greater than 5.0 out of 10.0. If the written exam is not passed, there will be a retake written exam. If neither the written exam nor the retake written exam is passed, the recorded grade will be the weighted average of the evaluation activities; if this average is greater than 5.0, the grade will be the highest failing mark (4.9). Attendance to classroom sessions is not a requirement to pass the course; however, active participation will score positively, adding to the final grade.
bibliography: MECHANICAL VIBRATION. THEORY AND APPLICATION. Graham Kelly

ELEMENTS OF VIBRATION ANALYSIS. Leonard Meirovitch
THEORY AND PROBLEMS OF MECHANICAL VIBRATIONS. Graham Kelly
